Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Beograd
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina traveling as tourists, in transit or for business purposes are exempted from visa requirements if they hold visa for United States of America, no matter from which country they enter Mexico and no matter which type of transport they use.Citizens of the United Mexican States are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
